description: Controlled vocabulary the catalog groups by. Items in this repository declare `category:` in their own frontmatter and are validated against these ids. A third-party source is not classified item by item: everything it contributes lands in the one bucket named for that source, so the tree stays honest about what is ours and what is imported.
